# FDG3026

> CONSIDER naming DLLs according to the following pattern:

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 3.3 Names of Assemblies, DLLs, and Packages.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application suggestion, test none
- Status: verified

## From the book

```csharp
<Company>.<Component>.dll
```

`<Component>` can contain more than one dot-separated clauses. For example:

```csharp
Microsoft.VisualBasic.dll
Microsoft.VisualBasic.Vsa.dll
Fabrikam.Security.dll
Litware.Controls.dll
```
